title_en: Good News (15/20): A New Glowing Frog
note_en: 甚至连…也… means "even… (of all people)": 连 marks the most unlikely person or thing, 也 (or 都) follows before the verb, and 甚至 adds extra emphasis. 甚至连专家也不完全确定其中的原因 "Even the experts aren't entirely sure why." English just puts "even" in front, but Chinese needs both 连 and 也/都 to frame the surprising element.
